title: nasturtium asperum
intro: Nasturtium asperum, commonly known as Indian cress or rough-cress, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family, known for its edible flowers, leaves, and stems. The health benefits of Nasturtium asperum include its high antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a natural antimicrobial agent, antiseptic, and wound healer, making it useful for treating minor cuts and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Nasturtium asperum include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and culinary uses.
